# AGENTS_ATLAS §no_hold_state_taxonomy: the teeth-test axis is the row's next acceptance step; retire "own PRs are primary"

Engine companion of the Skills ticket "Selection and continuation" (D#19384 delivery ticket 1, mechanism I). Graduated from [D#19384](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/19384) body v9 (anchor 2026-10-03T17:42:33Z).

## Context
The Skills ticket rewrites pickup §1 and the §L3 block; both point at the Atlas for the teeth-test. If the Atlas keeps ranking a PR above a plan, a read or a walk, the loaded rule still contradicts itself. Mnemosyne found the exact clause (D#19384 `18733609` §2).

## The Problem
`learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md` §no_hold_state_taxonomy says the warrant is "a principle with a teeth-test, NOT a closed list" (correct — neomjs/neo#13195 removed the idle-terminals list) and then says *"Own PRs are primary; collaboration is a valuable interruption you return from"*, treating own-ship-rate ≈ 0 as the drift signal. Written after three seats shipped 0–1 PRs while one shipped 10 — the opposite failure — it is where the substrate ranks a PR above the goal's next step. It is Engine-owned and was on no delivery list before the Discussion.

## The Architectural Reality
The Atlas is turn-loaded reference substrate (AGENTS.md §edge_case_triggers map). `.claude/CLAUDE.md` §L3 (generated from the Skills package) points at it. Byte discipline: the per-turn files gain nothing; the Atlas change is a rewrite of one paragraph.

## The Fix
Rewrite the taxonomy's axis: *an activity is not-holding only if it advances a row's next unresolved acceptance step, and a lane the working seat named itself is not NAMED until a second mind accepts it.* Both existing loophole guards survive; nothing becomes a membership list. Retire the "own PRs are primary" clause and its own-ship-rate drift signal; the drift signal becomes "a turn that advanced no acceptance step and produced no ranked proposal". Mnemosyne's measured text is in `18733609`.

## Decision Record impact
`aligned-with ADR 0007`. Decision Record: Not needed.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping
OQ7 `[RESOLVED_TO_AC]`: §L3 text (Skills) + this axis = one contract. OQ4 Tier 1.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The taxonomy paragraph carries the new axis; no activity list; net bytes ≤ current.
- [ ] "Own PRs are primary; collaboration is a valuable interruption" is gone; the replacement drift signal names the acceptance step.
- [ ] `.claude/CLAUDE.md` / AGENTS.md references to the taxonomy still resolve (grep in the PR body).
- [ ] Merges after the Skills parent's PR; the load receipt is ticket 5's.

## Out of Scope
Any other Atlas section; the per-turn CLAUDE.md (regenerated from Skills); FM work.

## Avoided Traps
Editing the generated CLAUDE.md copy by hand; a list of permitted activities.

## Related
D#19384 · Skills parent (linked) · neomjs/neo#13195.
